## What's wrong

A clear description of the bug.

## Where

- [ ] Playbook content (a rule/pattern is incorrect)
- [ ] MCP server / CLI (`email-playbook-mcp`)
- [ ] Hosted endpoint (`/api/mcp`)
- [ ] Playground / image-to-email
- [ ] Docs site (rendering, navigation, etc.)

## Email client (for rendering bugs)

If this is about email HTML rendering, name the client(s) — this is the most useful detail:

> e.g. Outlook 2019 (Windows), Gmail web, Apple Mail iOS 17

## To reproduce

Steps, the tool call or curl you ran, or the page URL.

## Expected vs actual

What you expected, and what happened instead. Paste output if relevant.

- Package version: `email-playbook-mcp@x.y.z`
- Node version:
- Client (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cline / terminal):
